description: WHM in-product survey metadata. Returned URLs may contain private tokens and are never fetched by the client.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Returns whether to display the survey banner and its link. The source declares x-readonly=false. display and new_user use the existing public integer 0|1 flag convention: exact quoted 0/1 source values normalize to integers and native 0/1 flags are accepted. max_dismiss remains an exact string when present and nonnull, and user_type is the documented whm string. Other strings, integers, booleans and fractions are not accepted for the two flags. Response fields retain optional presence. Returned links can contain private tokens; treat them as payload data and never fetch them automatically. Review 5721307565 (https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/70#pullrequestreview-5721307565) on cPanel 11.138.0.19 inspected InProductSurvey.pm and Cpanel/InProductSurvey.pm plus configuration: undefined links.whm.url, dismiss.max and submit event yield null link, max_dismiss and submit_event. This is source/config reasoning, not a survey call. The implementation saves start_time and a generated uuid under root inproductsurvey scope, and saves last_survey_link only when a link exists.

Client policy: use one form POST without automatic retry or rollback. Preserve optional fields, the three nullable strings, exact empty strings and strict sibling types. Returned URLs are private payload data and are never fetched automatically.
